nodes.label: 03 Financial Calculation Spec
nodes.rationale: The numbers contract: UI may format/hide but must never recompute with a different formula.

nodes.label: Pure calculation functions (no Date.now/DOM/API/mutation)
nodes.rationale: Deterministic, testable in Node; callers pass asOf. Spec suggests src/lib/financialCalculations.js; implemented in src/calculations/finance.js.

nodes.label: Integer Rupiah & basis-points representation
nodes.rationale: No decimal/finance library; safe integers on native Number; rate as annualRateBps (550 = 5.50%).

nodes.label: Rounding policy (roundMoney at output boundary, unrounded internal balances)
nodes.rationale: Prevents rounding accumulation; last row reconciles to zero.
nodes.norm_label: rounding policy (roundmoney at output boundary, unrounded internal balances)

nodes.label: CalculationError
nodes.rationale: Functions throw structured errors instead of returning sentinel NaN/Infinity/0.

nodes.label: calculateAnnuityPayment()
nodes.rationale: Uses log1p/expm1 for stability at very small rates; r = 0 → P/n.

nodes.label: calculateOutstanding()
nodes.rationale: Single-rate constant-payment only; if payment ever changed use official outstanding or full rate-period replay.

nodes.label: solveAnnualRateBps() — bounded bisection
nodes.rationale: Bisection over Newton: bounded, monotonic, derivative-free; rejects paymentEverChanged with UNSUPPORTED_SCENARIO; 5000 bps cap is a technical guard.

nodes.label: generateAmortizationSchedule()
nodes.rationale: No schedule when outstanding/tenor/rate coverage incomplete; UI shows partial state.

nodes.label: calculateDti()
nodes.rationale: Proposed DTI replaces old mortgage payment (no double count); thresholds come from bank policy.

nodes.label: calculatePropertyMetrics() (LTV, equity)
nodes.rationale: Negative equity allowed, never clamped.

nodes.label: calculateFloatingImpact()
nodes.rationale: Design numbers Rp4.250.000→Rp5.050.000 are inconsistent with the outstanding/tenor/rate trio and are not a calculation oracle.

nodes.norm_label: rate period shape & contiguity rules (startmonth/endmonth inclusive)

nodes.label: Cost item treatment (upfront / financed / deducted)

nodes.label: Cumulative net saving over max-tenor horizon

nodes.label: KPR Berjalan 3-Step Reminder Setup
nodes.rationale: Turns /monitoring/setup into a reminder tool (esp. before fixed->floating) that beginners finish without bank documents: steps KPR kamu, Bunga, Reminder; 5 required + 3 optional fields; percent 10/45/75 like the application wizards.

nodes.label: Satu data, satu tempat (single input location)
nodes.rationale: No question answered in one step is asked again elsewhere; every field (bankName, rate, finance, property, reminders) has exactly one input location.
nodes.norm_label: satu data, satu tempat (single input location)

nodes.label: Lengkapi nanti (complete-later prompts)
nodes.rationale: Features (KPR Health, amortization, LTV/top-up, Take Over simulation) are not removed; when data is missing they show a 'Lengkapi' link to the single place that field is asked, exactly when the feature needs it.

nodes.label: Derived sisa pinjaman (never asked)
nodes.rationale: Setup never asks outstanding principal; the mock API computes it from cicilan, bunga and sisa tenor via calculateMaxPrincipal. An official figure (outstandingEstimated=false) wins until cleared; recomputed only when an input changes so older estimates stay stable.

nodes.label: Mock API mortgage rules (saveSetupStep/update/activate)
nodes.rationale: Rules 1-8: derived outstanding, official outstanding, floating/null clears fixed-only fields, setupStep capped at 3, OFFICIAL_OUTSTANDING_REQUIRED removed from saveSetupStep, activate needs only bank/cicilan/dueDay (+fixedUntil) and valid reminders, profile finance sync, legacy fields untouched.

nodes.label: Empty-data-tolerant derive.js
nodes.rationale: Minimal reminder-only KPRs must not yield NaN or fake values: rateMode null for unknown type, paidRatio null without principal, healthScore null with 'Belum lengkap', paymentWindow without startDate filter.

nodes.label: Rate type 'Belum tahu' (currentRateType null)
nodes.rationale: Beginners may not know their rate type; payment reminders still activate, no made-up 'normal' rate score, and Home asks to fill the rate type later.

nodes.label: Legacy 6-step draft compatibility (no schema migration)
nodes.rationale: Saved drafts and active KPRs stay readable without schemaVersion migration: /monitoring/setup/4..6 redirect to 3, setupStep > 3 read as 3 everywhere a draft resumes.

nodes.label: Profile finance sync to mortgages
nodes.rationale: profile.update merges finance into draft/active mortgages so KPR Health stops reading a stale income copy; db.finance is the one source.

nodes.label: Full edit mode only for active KPR
nodes.rationale: Spec clarification: optional fields (product name, scheme, original principal, official outstanding) appear only when an active KPR is edited from My KPR/Home; 'Ubah' from the draft review keeps the simple form so beginners do not see extra fields mid-setup.
nodes.norm_label: full edit mode only for active kpr

nodes.label: 3-phase grouping (group, not merge screens)
nodes.rationale: 7 short screens grouped into 3 phases (Tentang Kamu, Rumah & Pinjaman, Pilih Bank & Kirim) so the form feels lighter, while routes, autosave, currentStep, relevantStep and resumePath stay unchanged.

nodes.label: Front-loaded rounded progress percent
nodes.rationale: Percent rounded to multiples of 5 and fast early (10,30,45,60,75,85,95) so the user feels far along; phase ends at 45% / 75%.

nodes.label: Milestone insight screen
nodes.rationale: Each phase closes with a separate screen (not a card or dialog) rewarding the user with real numbers from the bank catalog, only when they can be computed.

nodes.label: Milestone via location.state + replace navigation
nodes.rationale: Save navigates with state {milestone}; 'Lanjut ke Tahap N' navigates with replace and no state, so browser back/reload from the next form never re-shows the milestone; not shown when editing from Review or resuming a draft.

nodes.label: Progress from furthest saved screen
nodes.rationale: Bar and percent use max(open screen, currentStep) so stepping back to edit never lowers progress.

nodes.label: Primary Milestone 1: Affordability insights
nodes.rationale: Cicilan aman, Plafon KPR hingga, Harga rumah hingga, open-program chip via api.bankProducts.affordability. Uses the fixed rate because the first installment in generateAmortizationSchedule is a fixed-rate annuity over the full tenor, the same thing comparePrimaryPrograms judges (withinCapacity).

nodes.label: Primary Milestone 2: Matching programs insights
nodes.rationale: Program cocok, Cicilan mulai, Rasio cicilan vs 35% capacity from the existing api.bankProducts.compare; no new function.

nodes.label: Open bank program eligibility rule
nodes.rationale: Active and valid at asOf, productTypes includes primary, income >= minimumIncome, occupation allowed, age >= minimumAge, max tenor = min(maximumTenorMonths, (maximumAgeAtMaturity - age) x 12) >= 12; property type and LTV unknown at this phase so not filtered.

nodes.label: Ballpark rounding (floor to Rp10 jt with ±)
nodes.rationale: Plafon and house price shown floored to Rp10 jt with a ± prefix; rounding is display-only, calculation functions keep exact rupiah.
nodes.norm_label: ballpark rounding (floor to rp10 jt with ±)

nodes.label: Take Over 9-screen / 3-phase progress
nodes.rationale: 9 progress screens mapped onto phases Kamu & KPR Lama, Kondisi & Tujuan, Pilih Bank & Kirim with percents 10..95; phase ends land on the same 45% / 75% as Primary. Routes, autosave, currentStep and the Explore simulation flow unchanged.

nodes.label: currentStep to furthest screen mapping
nodes.rationale: currentStep 1..7 maps to screens 1,3,4,5,6,7|8,9; step 6 depends on whether a program selection exists.

nodes.label: Take Over Milestone 1: Tahap 1 selesai
nodes.rationale: After the old loan is confirmed, shows what staying with the old bank costs (remaining interest, principal paid, rate status, payoff month). Pure client-side math from app.data and clock, so no loading or error state.

nodes.label: Take Over Milestone 2: Baseline 'Tahap 2 selesai' banner
nodes.rationale: Milestone 2 is the existing Baseline page plus a banner (no extra screen or click), shown only when sim.source.type === 'application'; health ring + one teaser line from sim.items.

nodes.rationale: Widgets missing data render locked: 'Data belum lengkap', what is missing, one complete-data button. In the gallery locked cards cannot be added; the button becomes 'Lengkapi data'.

nodes.label: Recharts 3 lazy-loaded chart widgets
nodes.rationale: Recharts 3 (responsive, CSS token colors, animation 'auto' respects reduced motion) in one lazy chunk via React.lazy; the ratio gauge uses CSS conic-gradient like HealthRing so it stays out of the Recharts chunk.

nodes.label: Query: data for Home dashboard widgets (charts, pipeline)
nodes.norm_label: query: data for home dashboard widgets (charts, pipeline)

nodes.label: Home widget data sources (deriveMortgage outputs, mortgage fields, explore, activities, simulation snapshot)
nodes.rationale: All widget data already exists: deriveMortgage() exposes mode, daysUntilFixedEnd, milestone, nextDue, schedule rows (principal/interest/closingBalance), estimatedEndDate, dti, equity/ltvRatio, paidRatio, floatingImpact and health components, so new widgets need no new data layer.
nodes.norm_label: home widget data sources (derivemortgage outputs, mortgage fields, explore, activities, simulation snapshot)

nodes.label: Div-based stacked bar chart pattern (role=img)
nodes.rationale: Existing chart pattern in AmortizationPages.jsx uses plain divs with role=img instead of a chart library; reuse it for widget charts.

nodes.label: RuangKPR (Personal KPR Financial Assistant)
nodes.rationale: Positioned as a dashboard that keeps a KPR under control for its whole lifetime, not a better calculator.

nodes.label: Frontend-first delivery scope (Vite+React JS, shadcn/ui, mock API, pure JS calc engine)
nodes.rationale: Locked scope: build UI against mock adapter and JSON fixtures before any real backend/database/provider is chosen.
nodes.norm_label: frontend-first delivery scope (vite+react js, shadcn/ui, mock api, pure js calc engine)

nodes.label: Know -> Warn -> Act principle
nodes.rationale: Know = understand KPR state; Warn = payment reminders and fixed-to-floating early warning; Act = simulate, compare, apply to one bank.

nodes.label: Product principles (show less, progressive disclosure, estimate is not approval, no silent submission)
nodes.rationale: Home = glance, detail = understand, compare = decide; all estimates carry disclaimers; data goes to a bank only after consent and explicit submit.
nodes.norm_label: product principles (show less, progressive disclosure, estimate is not approval, no silent submission)

nodes.label: Deterministic financial math (AI never produces authoritative numbers)
nodes.rationale: Rates, balances, eligibility and approval must come from the calculation engine; AI may only explain deterministic results later (see §20.5).
nodes.norm_label: deterministic financial math (ai never produces authoritative numbers)

nodes.label: One application = one bank/program
nodes.rationale: No multi-bank submission in MVP; matches the initial one-bank operational model.

nodes.label: No false integration claims (manual payment is user-recorded)
nodes.rationale: Manual payments must never be presented as bank-synced; trackers reflect backend status, not fake timers.
nodes.norm_label: no false integration claims (manual payment is user-recorded)

nodes.label: Navigation: Home | My KPR | Explore | Activity | Profile
nodes.rationale: Static shell, dynamic content: five items always present and never disabled; content changes with lifecycle state.
nodes.norm_label: navigation: home | my kpr | explore | activity | profile

nodes.label: Visual baseline (Plus Jakarta Sans, #003DA5, #F4F6FA, Command Center header)
nodes.rationale: Approved Claude Design artifact is the visual source; no new shell or visual language without explicit approval.
nodes.norm_label: visual baseline (plus jakarta sans, #003da5, #f4f6fa, command center header)

nodes.label: Home render priority (rejected > in-process > draft > setup draft > warning > floating > normal > fresh)
nodes.rationale: MVP assumes one active application or setup draft and one active mortgage per user, so a single priority order decides Home content.
nodes.norm_label: home render priority (rejected > in-process > draft > setup draft > warning > floating > normal > fresh)

nodes.label: Application state machine (draft -> submitted -> ... -> disbursed; rejected/cancelled)
nodes.rationale: Cancel pre-akad is a hard delete by current product decision; retention/regulatory requirement must be validated before production.
nodes.norm_label: application state machine (draft -> submitted -> ... -> disbursed; rejected/cancelled)

nodes.label: Mortgage state (draft -> active -> closed)
nodes.rationale: mortgage.draft holds unfinished monitoring setup and never creates an application.

nodes.label: KPR Primary application flow (5 steps: product, data, documents, compare, review & submit)
nodes.rationale: Primary covers both new and used houses; no separate Secondary product, flow or engine.
nodes.norm_label: kpr primary application flow (5 steps: product, data, documents, compare, review & submit)

nodes.label: Payment capacity formula (safe payment = ratio_config x income; default 35%)
nodes.rationale: 35% is a prototype default only; ratio must be configurable per product/bank policy. Programs over capacity stay visible with warning.
nodes.norm_label: payment capacity formula (safe payment = ratio_config x income; default 35%)

nodes.label: Rule-based bank product matching and recommendation label
nodes.rationale: Not AI: recommendation only if estimated eligible, within capacity, product data current, and best by sorting objective.
nodes.norm_label: rule-based bank product matching and recommendation label

nodes.label: Application tracker and rejected recovery (clone to other bank / retry same bank)
nodes.norm_label: application tracker and rejected recovery (clone to other bank / retry same bank)

nodes.label: Existing KPR setup wizard (6 steps: Data KPR, Bunga & Cicilan, Properti, Keuangan, Reminder, Review)
nodes.rationale: Lets existing owners set up monitoring in 5-8 minutes without documents; activation flips mortgage draft to active and creates no application.
nodes.norm_label: existing kpr setup wizard (6 steps: data kpr, bunga & cicilan, properti, keuangan, reminder, review)

nodes.label: Payment-changed accuracy branch (no single-rate reverse engineering)
nodes.rationale: If payment never changed the engine may solve effective rate and estimate outstanding; if it changed, official outstanding/rate/tenor are required because a single-rate solve would be wrong.
nodes.norm_label: payment-changed accuracy branch (no single-rate reverse engineering)

nodes.label: Rate periods (fixed -> fixed -> floating; ordered, no overlap/gap)
nodes.rationale: Floating future value is always an estimate; active-period-only input is allowed but forces partial-data state for full-schedule features.
nodes.norm_label: rate periods (fixed -> fixed -> floating; ordered, no overlap/gap)

nodes.label: Home monitoring dashboard (Health, Next Payment, Warning, Progress, Opportunity; no charts by default)
nodes.rationale: No charts on Home keeps it a 5-10 second glance. 2026-10-05 note: rule applies to the default layout only; charts (Proyeksi Sisa Pokok, Dampak Floating, Komposisi Cicilan, Pokok vs Bunga per Tahun) are opt-in widgets via Atur Dashboard -> Tambah widget.
nodes.norm_label: home monitoring dashboard (health, next payment, warning, progress, opportunity; no charts by default)

nodes.label: KPR Health composite score (DTI, LTV, rate risk, loan progress)
nodes.rationale: Not a bank credit score; weights must be configurable and documented; incomplete inputs yield a partial score instead of false precision.
nodes.norm_label: kpr health composite score (dti, ltv, rate risk, loan progress)

nodes.label: Fixed-to-floating early warning (H-90/60/30/14/7)
nodes.rationale: Triggers when 0 < days_until_fixed_end <= 90; becomes the hero card showing current vs estimated floating payment delta with Stay / Compare Take Over / Request Repricing CTAs.

nodes.label: Partial-data state (missing property value or rate/outstanding)
nodes.rationale: Missing data never blocks reminders and never produces fake estimates; show explicit fields to complete.
nodes.norm_label: partial-data state (missing property value or rate/outstanding)

nodes.label: My KPR tabs (Overview | Payment | Rate | Property)
nodes.rationale: No new sidebar items; Rate tab shows a rate-period timeline; Property tab shows estimated equity/LTV with not-an-appraisal disclaimers.
nodes.norm_label: my kpr tabs (overview | payment | rate | property)

nodes.label: Amortization schedule (summary, annual stacked chart, monthly/yearly table, financial invariants)
nodes.rationale: Placed under My KPR -> Payment, not top-level nav. Generated from inputs, not persisted per row; cache only if measured performance needs it. Invariants: sum(principal)=opening, sum(payment)=principal+interest, final balance 0 within tolerance.
nodes.norm_label: amortization schedule (summary, annual stacked chart, monthly/yearly table, financial invariants)

nodes.label: Explore with active mortgage (Take Over floating/opportunity signals)
nodes.rationale: Without an active mortgage only education cards render (not disabled). Refinancing/Multiguna badges deferred until reliable valuation rules exist.
nodes.norm_label: explore with active mortgage (take over floating/opportunity signals)

nodes.label: Simulation separated from application (Simpan Simulasi vs Ajukan Sekarang)
nodes.rationale: Saving a simulation never creates an application; Apply Now creates one prefilled draft, preserving no-silent-submission.
nodes.norm_label: simulation separated from application (simpan simulasi vs ajukan sekarang)

nodes.label: Take Over flow (baseline, total moving cost, break-even, old KPR settlement tracker)
nodes.rationale: Take Over is judged on total cost and break-even, not promo rate; existing users skip the cold-entry wizard.
nodes.norm_label: take over flow (baseline, total moving cost, break-even, old kpr settlement tracker)

nodes.label: Refinancing + Top-up requirement framework
nodes.rationale: Needs partner policy validation; no authoritative recommendation until policies exist.

nodes.label: Multiguna requirement framework (property-secured loan)
nodes.rationale: Reuse calculation engine and bank product engine with product_type=multiguna; no separate engine unless bank rules prove materially different.

nodes.label: Notification reliability (idempotent scheduling, dedupe per event/milestone/channel)
nodes.rationale: MVP channels are in-app and email; WhatsApp only once a provider exists. Reminders stop after mortgage closed or setting disabled.
nodes.norm_label: notification reliability (idempotent scheduling, dedupe per event/milestone/channel)

nodes.label: Conceptual data model (users, applications, mortgages, rate_periods, properties, payments, bank_products, simulations)
nodes.norm_label: conceptual data model (users, applications, mortgages, rate_periods, properties, payments, bank_products, simulations)

nodes.label: Calculation engine requirements (annuity, solve-for-rate, rate periods, DTI/LTV, take over costs)
nodes.rationale: Use decimal-safe money calculations, not binary float, and define rounding with final-installment reconciliation.
nodes.norm_label: calculation engine requirements (annuity, solve-for-rate, rate periods, dti/ltv, take over costs)

nodes.label: Break-even formula (moving_cost / monthly_benefit)
nodes.rationale: If monthly_benefit <= 0, never show positive break-even; label it as not reached and evaluate total-cost differences separately.

nodes.label: Bank product data governance (versioned, effective dates, stale threshold)
nodes.rationale: Stale product data is a top operational risk; stale beyond threshold shows a warning or disables the recommendation label.
nodes.norm_label: bank product data governance (versioned, effective dates, stale threshold)

nodes.label: Security, privacy, consent and compliance requirements
nodes.rationale: Never request/store bank password, PIN or banking OTP; no public document URLs; consent version and timestamp recorded.
nodes.norm_label: security, privacy, consent and compliance requirements

nodes.label: API adapter boundary (mockApi / httpApi, same contract)
nodes.rationale: Components never call fetch, read HTTP status, touch fixtures or add delays; swapping mock for HTTP must not change components, routes, UI state or view-model mappers.
nodes.norm_label: api adapter boundary (mockapi / httpapi, same contract)

nodes.label: ApiError
nodes.rationale: Single normalized error (code, status, details, fieldErrors, requestId, retryable) thrown identically by both adapters.

nodes.label: Response envelope (ok, data, meta, error) and cursor pagination
nodes.rationale: One cursor pagination pattern for every list; has_more and cursor are authoritative, total may be null.
nodes.norm_label: response envelope (ok, data, meta, error) and cursor pagination

nodes.label: Money as integer minor units (amount, currency, scale)
nodes.rationale: Integers avoid binary float errors; IDR keeps scale 2 for cross-currency consistency; UI formats from typed values, never display strings.
nodes.norm_label: money as integer minor units (amount, currency, scale)

nodes.label: Rate and ratio in basis points (value_bps, is_estimate)
nodes.rationale: Logic uses value_bps (DTI 3833 = 38.33%, LTV 4882 = 48.82%); display_percent is convenience only; is_estimate required on numbers that could be mistaken for official values.
nodes.norm_label: rate and ratio in basis points (value_bps, is_estimate)

nodes.label: Idempotency-Key (create, submit, activate, mark-paid, simulation apply)
nodes.norm_label: idempotency-key (create, submit, activate, mark-paid, simulation apply)

nodes.label: Applications contract (enum, transitions, save step capacity, submit, retry, cloneToBank)
nodes.rationale: After submit the snapshot is immutable; disbursed automatically creates/activates a mortgage from final akad terms, not simulation.
nodes.norm_label: applications contract (enum, transitions, save step capacity, submit, retry, clonetobank)

nodes.label: Document upload metadata flow (createUpload -> completeUpload, mock:// URL)
nodes.rationale: Binary upload is outside JSON payloads; components call the adapter's upload helper instead of PUTting themselves; no public preview URLs stored.
nodes.norm_label: document upload metadata flow (createupload -> completeupload, mock:// url)

nodes.label: Bank products resource and compare (eligibility, rate_periods, fees, capacity, recommended)
nodes.rationale: Over-capacity programs still appear with warning; expired products are excluded and selecting drafts get BANK_PRODUCT_EXPIRED on submit.
nodes.norm_label: bank products resource and compare (eligibility, rate_periods, fees, capacity, recommended)

nodes.label: Mortgage setup and activate contract (6 setup steps, rate branch, activate)
nodes.rationale: Activate returns application_created:false and scheduled_reminder_count; payment_ever_changed:true requires official outstanding or OFFICIAL_OUTSTANDING_REQUIRED.
nodes.norm_label: mortgage setup and activate contract (6 setup steps, rate branch, activate)

nodes.label: Rate periods atomic replace (PUT, coverage full/partial)
nodes.norm_label: rate periods atomic replace (put, coverage full/partial)

nodes.label: Property contract (estimated_equity, ltv_bps, is_official_appraisal)
nodes.rationale: If value is null, equity and LTV are null while reminders keep working.

nodes.label: Reminders contract (payment/fixed-expiry offsets, channel availability, dedupe_key)
nodes.rationale: WhatsApp reported unavailable (coming_soon) rather than simulated as delivered.
nodes.norm_label: reminders contract (payment/fixed-expiry offsets, channel availability, dedupe_key)

nodes.label: Amortization contract (summary, rate_assumptions, rows, totals, reconciliation)
nodes.rationale: Missing data returns AMORTIZATION_UNAVAILABLE with missing_fields; never a fake schedule.
nodes.norm_label: amortization contract (summary, rate_assumptions, rows, totals, reconciliation)

nodes.label: Simulations contract (run, save, apply; break_even_status)
nodes.rationale: Save never creates an application and honestly reports history_not_enabled; apply creates exactly one prefilled draft without altering the active mortgage.

nodes.label: Activities contract (event types, category, action route)
nodes.norm_label: activities contract (event types, category, action route)

nodes.label: Aggregate home contract (api.home.get: state, priority_reason, cards)
nodes.rationale: Aggregate endpoint avoids Home assembling priority from many racing requests.
nodes.norm_label: aggregate home contract (api.home.get: state, priority_reason, cards)

nodes.label: Named fixture scenarios and deterministic clock (fresh, mortgage_active_h90, ...)
nodes.rationale: One domain JSON fixture without per-screen response duplication; mock handlers derive contract responses from state.
nodes.norm_label: named fixture scenarios and deterministic clock (fresh, mortgage_active_h90, ...)

nodes.label: createMockApi() and __control.failNext (dev-only mock controls)
nodes.rationale: __control is not part of the public adapter and must not be imported by app runtime.

nodes.label: State-transition response and audit rules (transition, idempotent_replay)
nodes.norm_label: state-transition response and audit rules (transition, idempotent_replay)

nodes.label: Adapter contract tests minimum (18 checks against mockApi and httpApi)
nodes.norm_label: adapter contract tests minimum (18 checks against mockapi and httpapi)

nodes.label: Deliberate MVP simplifications (single active record, on-demand amortization, hard-delete cancel)
nodes.rationale: Keeps the UI surface and domain payload stable while the backend behind httpApi is decided later.
nodes.norm_label: deliberate mvp simplifications (single active record, on-demand amortization, hard-delete cancel)

nodes.label: KPR Card Illustration (house icon with notification bell)
nodes.rationale: 3D-rendered white house on a frosted-glass rounded-square (squircle) tile, with a red bell badge at top-right. Shows a mortgage (KPR) property card visual that signals alerts or reminders tied to the user's home loan. The soft neutral palette and large radius match the app's rounded-card visual language.
nodes.norm_label: kpr card illustration (house icon with notification bell)

nodes.label: Auth Cover Image (cover-auth.webp)
nodes.description: Wide 2752x1536 lifestyle photo: a smiling young Asian family (father, mother, small daughter with string lights) standing in a bright, sunlit living room of a newly moved-into home, surrounded by cardboard moving boxes, a rolled rug, potted plants, and a floating shelf being installed. Warm neutral palette (cream walls, beige curtains, wood floor).
nodes.rationale: Filename indicates use as the visual cover/hero for authentication (login/register) screens; the move-in family scene conveys the emotional payoff of a successful KPR (home mortgage), reinforcing trust and aspiration at sign-up.

nodes.label: New Home Ownership / Move-in Moment
nodes.rationale: Depicts the end goal of the KPR journey: a family settling into their own home, used as aspirational brand imagery.

nodes.label: Auth Screen Hero Visual
nodes.rationale: Inferred from 'cover-auth' filename: decorative cover image placed beside or behind the login/registration form; wide aspect ratio suits a split-screen desktop layout.

nodes.label: Self-Service Mortgage (KPR) Planning at Home
nodes.rationale: Lifestyle marketing photo: a woman in a calm, warm modern home reviews mortgage numbers on tablet and laptop with a calculator and notebook, conveying that KPR planning can be done independently, calmly, and with clear data. Likely used as a service/feature card visual.

nodes.label: Service Image 2: Home Financial Planning Photo
nodes.description: Warm-lit lifestyle photo of a woman at a wooden dining table in a terraced house, writing on printed documents next to a calculator and a laptop showing a spreadsheet with blue bar charts. Bookshelves, plants and a residential street are visible through the windows. It is a service section illustration.
nodes.norm_label: service image 2: home financial planning photo

nodes.label: Home Mortgage (KPR) Budget Planning
nodes.rationale: The image puts the service in a calm, everyday setting. A homeowner works through mortgage numbers on her own at home, which makes KPR planning feel approachable instead of institutional.

nodes.label: Warm Residential Lifestyle Photography Style
nodes.rationale: Golden-hour lighting, a lived-in home interior and a terraced-house street view tie the service to the experience of owning a home and suggest trust and comfort.

nodes.label: Service Image 3 - Couple Reviewing Floor Plans
nodes.description: Lifestyle photo: a smiling middle-aged Asian couple on a cream sofa in a bright, minimal living room, reviewing architectural floor plans and printed documents on a wooden coffee table. Warm neutral palette (beige, wood, plants). Used as a marketing/service card visual.
nodes.norm_label: service image 3 - couple reviewing floor plans

nodes.label: Home Purchase / Renovation Planning
nodes.rationale: Floor plans plus paperwork signal a household planning a property purchase or build, which positions the KPR (mortgage) service as a calm, collaborative decision rather than a stressful transaction.

nodes.label: Warm Lifestyle Imagery Style
nodes.rationale: Natural light, neutral tones, and relaxed body language convey trust and approachability for a financial-service landing section.

Mock-first data boundary rules
Definition of Done verification checks
